dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The module describes the operation of an average plant in the region. The plant is used for middle load with 4000 hours of operation at full capacity per year. The plant is assumed to operate 150000 hours during its lifetime. For the assessment of main characteristics (LHV, sulphur and ash content of coal, efficiency of the plant) and criteria emissions (SOx, NOx, particles, mercury) a bottom-up approach has been used based on legal emission limits in the region and supplemented by typical emission factors in cases of data gaps (based on EEA/EPA). CO2, CH4 and N2O emissions have been derived from fuel types (from IEA data) and IPCC emission factors. Airborne emission data has been updated for 2019, whereas other inputs and outputs come from the original dataset. The dataset consists on the collection of information about single plants. Base data on all major power plants in 2019 have been integrated, to the extent possible. The size distribution of particles has been derived from non-linear calculations based on typical ratios for different total emission amounts based on CEPMEIP. Emissions of trace substances (except for mercury) were derived from emission factors in the literature (EEA/EPA). The waste heat releases to air and water have been allocated on the basis of the assumed share of river cooled power plants and assumptions on the direct losses to air. The share of the recycled ash is country-specific. For the disposal of the remaining ash, typical country-specific compositions are taken into account in appropriate disposal modules. technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Average installed technology.

# Included processes
Energy conversion for energy supply. Use of fuel oil for startup is accounted for. Particle removal is included in this module. DeSOx and DeNOx are described in different modules; they are applied here according to a simplified estimate assuming an average unabated emission and the specific abated regional emission rates; SOx and NOx emissions are the reduced ones. It is assumed that 25 % of the plants are river cooled, 75 % use cooling tower (average UCTE). The water treatment is described in separate modules. The disposal of non-recycled ashes is modelled separately.
